problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical trucks. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: size 51 cubic feet
* Shipment Beta: size 70 cubic feet
* Shipment Gamma: size 41 cubic feet
* Shipment Delta: size 55 cubic feet
* Shipment Epsilon: size 46 cubic feet
* Shipment Zeta: size 41 cubic feet
* Shipment Eta: size 40 cubic feet
* Shipment Theta: size 35 cubic feet
* Shipment Iota: size 43 cubic feet
* Shipment Kappa: size 70 cubic feet
* Shipment Lambda: size 63 cubic feet
* Shipment Mu: size 52 cubic feet
* Shipment Nu: size 59 cubic feet
* Shipment Xi: size 35 cubic feet
* Shipment Omicron: size 51 cubic feet
* Shipment Pi: size 63 cubic feet
* Shipment Rho: size 57 cubic feet
* Shipment Sigma: size 49 cubic feet
* Shipment Tau: size 59 cubic feet
* Shipment Upsilon: size 33 cubic feet
* Shipment Phi: size 38 cubic feet
* Shipment Chi: size 52 cubic feet
* Shipment Psi: size 41 cubic feet
* Shipment Omega: size 61 cubic feet
* Shipment Arrow: size 44 cubic feet
* Shipment Bolt: size 44 cubic feet
* Shipment Star: size 34 cubic feet
* Shipment Wave: size 38 cubic feet
* Shipment Cube: size 58 cubic feet
* Shipment Spark: size 57 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all shipments using the fewest trucks possible. Every shipment must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of shipments in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
